item.description: Former Labour Party presidential candidate, Peter Obi, is reportedly set to officially join the African Democratic Congress (ADC) ahead of the 2027 general elections.This was disclosed by a top official of the ADC in Abuja, who said plans are already in motion for Obi’s defection.
